item.title: Amazon S3 Vectors introduces metadata pre-filtering for up to 5x higher recall on filtered search
item.description: Amazon S3 Vectors now supports pre-filtering, which evaluates metadata filters before running similarity search, returning up to 5x more of the matching vectors when your filter is selective. S3 Vectors also adds a prefix match operator ($startsWith) for filtering on values like paths and URLs. item.title: AWS Parallel Computing Service now supports scaling logs
item.description: AWS Parallel Computing Service (AWS PCS) now supports scaling logs, which record how AWS PCS scales the compute node groups in your cluster.
